children: Las Vegas, Nevada--(Newsfile Corp. - November 2, 2026) - Complete Defense Solutions ("CDS") today directed Complete Financial Solutions, Inc. (OTCID: CFSU) ("CFS" or the "Company") shareholders to a new video from Ai Arsenals, Inc. ("AiA"), that explains AiA plans for secured AI compute and defense manufacturing services.

On October 6, 2026, the Company announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, CDS, entered into a Binding Letter of Intent under which CDS would acquire newly issued AiA Series A Preferred Stock intended to equal 9% of AiA's total valuation at the time of completing the proposed transaction, in exchange for the Company's Series A Defense Preferred Stock (the "Exchange"). The video is intended to help CFS shareholders understand the business and service offerings provided by Ai Arsenals.

"While the proposed transaction is pending, CDS and AiA are working to align CDS's defense M&A strategy with the advanced manufacturing solutions, and resilient energy solutions to all companies CDS may acquire," said Ken Tapp, a Director of Complete Defense Solutions. "The defense manufacturers that CDS is focused on acquiring need more than capital to meet their growth goals. They need secured AI compute, AI-ready manufacturing facilities at sovereign secured locations that are most convenient for them to scale. That is what Ai Arsenals is working to build, and I recorded this video to speak directly to the leaders of those companies, and other U.S. defense company executives, about how to implement current and future AI manufacturing solutions."
Watch Video: "A Message to America's Defense Manufacturers" from Ken Tapp:

"In October we put the Binding Letter of Intent with Ai Arsenals on the record," said Jeff Gabrelcik, CEO of Complete Financial Solutions, Inc. "Today we are describing what we intend to acquire: a shared foundation of provided sovereign AI and manufacturing solutions that AiA plans to provide, which a single defense manufacturer may find it difficult to build on its own."

children: CFS and CDS continue to evaluate strategic AI and defense partnerships, acquisition targets, AI-driven manufacturing investment opportunities, and advanced technology relationships, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality around proprietary, commercial and defense-related information. Due to non-disclosure agreements in place with CFS, CDS, AiA and other companies in the defense industry and financial markets, information provided to the public is limited to only what is permitted. The companies will continue to provide educational media to shareholders in order to keep them abreast of the progress made and the business plans.
About Complete Financial Solutions, Inc.

Complete Financial Solutions, Inc. is a U.S.-based holding company focused on strategic opportunities across defense, aerospace, space, advanced technology, manufacturing, infrastructure and related markets. The Company acquires businesses focused on National and Economic Security Priorities, creating strategies and partnerships with government, military, and law enforcement agencies to accelerate initiatives ensuring national security and safety.
About Complete Defense Solutions, Inc.

Complete Defense Solutions is a management holding company with a strategy centered on connecting institutional capital, next generation military technology, AI driven defense manufacturing and strategic relationships to support scalable domestic defense capabilities.
Complete Defense Solutions - Web Site
About Ai Arsenals, Inc.

Ai Arsenals, Inc. is a sovereign secure AI and defense manufacturing company. It integrates sovereign secure AI compute, TS/SCI-capable mission operations, adjacent advanced defense manufacturing, technology transition, allied technology on-shoring, industrial mobilization capability and resilient energy infrastructure at secured locations across the United States.
Ai Arsenals - Web Site
About NSPM-11

In June 2026, the White House issued National Security Presidential Memorandum 11 (NSPM-11), a directive that fundamentally changes how the Department of War, the Intelligence Community, and other national security agencies acquire and use artificial intelligence.
NSPM-11 - Web Site
